# @stackline/angular-data-table-component

> Angular 22 data table with sorting, filtering, pagination, selection, grouping, pinning, virtualization, templates, and a headless controller.

Current version: 22.1.0
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stackline/angular-data-table-component
Repository: https://github.com/alexandroit/angular-data-table-component
Documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/angular/angular-data-table-component/angular-22/
License: MIT

## Install

```bash
npm install @stackline/angular-data-table-component
```

## Compatibility

- @angular/common: >=22.0.0 <23.0.0
- @angular/core: >=22.0.0 <23.0.0
- Historical package majors match their Angular majors.

## Main Exports

- DataTableModule
- DataTableComponent
- HeadlessDataTableController
- createDataTableController
- Data table column, event, state, pinning, filtering, and template context types
